name: Code check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: ["*"]
  push:
    branches: ["main"]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

env:
  FORCE_COLOR: 3

jobs:
  format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Format
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/setup

      - name: Check formatting
        run: pnpm format:check

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Lint
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/setup

      - run: pnpm lint
      - run: pnpm check:bases

  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Typecheck
    env:
      SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/setup

      - run: pnpm typecheck

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Test
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/setup

      - run: pnpm test

  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: E2E
    timeout-minutes: 20
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17.4
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: tablecn
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: securepassword
          POSTGRES_DB: tablecn
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U tablecn -d tablecn"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://tablecn:securepassword@localhost:5432/tablecn
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/setup

      - name: Enable extensions
        run: pnpm exec tsx src/db/extensions.ts

      - name: Create the database
        run: pnpm exec drizzle-kit push --force

      - name: Seed
        run: pnpm exec tsx src/db/seed.ts

      - name: Install Playwright
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm exec next build

      - name: Test
        run: pnpm test:e2e

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
